releaseNotes:
• New: Intimate Video & Audio Guard — detects kissing, bed scenes, explicit content & internal playback moaning/groaning/panting audio (via YAMNet + SwiftFormer ONNX, no mic needed).
• New: Blur First, Then Act — shields the screen immediately before skipping scenes forward (Movies/Series like Stremio/Nuvio/YouTube), swiping to Next Reel (Instagram/Facebook/Shorts/TikTok), or pausing & pressing Back in browsers.
• New: DRM Streaming Policy (Netflix, Prime Video, Hotstar) — choose Warn Only, Auto-Block, or Off where Android hardware DRM blocks screen & audio capture.
